```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(GGally)
library(patchwork)
library(whychusInputs)
```

# 1. Join and Prepare Data

```{r prepare-data}
# Pivot forecasts wide — one row per date, columns per variable
forecasts_wide <- all_historical_forecasts |>
  filter(lead_days == 1) |>          # use day-1 forecast for EDA
  select(valid_date, variable, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
  rename(
    date       = valid_date,
    air_max_c  = temperature_2m_max,
    air_min_c  = temperature_2m_min,
    cloud_pct  = cloud_cover_mean
  )

# Pull observed water temp — max and mean (Camp Polk)
obs_wide <- camp_polk_historical |>
  filter(variable == "water temperature (c)") |>
  filter(statistic %in% c("max", "mean")) |>
  select(date, statistic, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = statistic, values_from = value) |>
  rename(twater_max = max, twater_mean = mean)

# Pull observed flow (Camp Polk)
obs_flow <- camp_polk_historical |>
  filter(variable == "discharge (cfs)") |>
  select(date, Q = value)

# Join everything
df <- obs_wide |>
  left_join(forecasts_wide, by = "date") |>
  left_join(obs_flow,       by = "date") |>
  mutate(
    year      = year(date),
    month     = month(date),
    julian    = yday(date),
    month_lab = month(date, label = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(month >= 5, month <= 9) |>   # May–September only
  arrange(date)

# Add lag variables (previous day)
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    Q_lag1       = lag(Q,         1),
    air_max_lag1 = lag(air_max_c, 1),
    air_min_lag1 = lag(air_min_c, 1),
    twater_lag1  = lag(twater_max, 1)
  )

cat("Rows available for modeling:", nrow(drop_na(df)), "\n")
glimpse(df)
```

# 2. Annual Trends — Has Temperature Been Changing Over Time?

```{r annual-trends}
p_annual <- df |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax  = mean(twater_max,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tmean = mean(twater_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(c(mean_tmax, mean_tmean), names_to = "stat", values_to = "temp") |>
  mutate(stat = recode(stat,
                       mean_tmax  = "Max water temp",
                       mean_tmean = "Mean water temp"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = temp, color = stat)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Max water temp"  = "#9A8822",
                                "Mean water temp" = "#F5CDB4")) +
  labs(title = "Annual mean water temperature at Camp Polk (May–Sep)",
       x = NULL, y = "°C", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_annual)
```

# 3. Seasonal Pattern — How Does Temperature Vary Through the Season?

```{r seasonal-pattern}
p_seasonal <- df |>
  group_by(julian) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(twater_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tmax   = sd(twater_max,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = julian)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_tmax - sd_tmax,
                  ymax = mean_tmax + sd_tmax),
              fill = "#74A089", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_tmax), color = "#74A089", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal water temperature pattern at Camp Polk (mean ± 1 SD)",
       x = "Julian day", y = "Max water temp (°C)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_seasonal)
```

# 4. Scatterplots — Water Temp vs Each Predictor

```{r scatterplots, fig.height=8}
scatter_vars   <- c("air_max_c", "air_min_c", "cloud_pct", "Q", "julian")
scatter_labels <- c("Air max (°C)", "Air min (°C)", "Cloud cover (%)",
                    "Flow (Q)", "Julian day")

plots <- map2(scatter_vars, scatter_labels, function(var, lab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = twater_max, color = month_lab)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black",
                linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", name = "Month") +
    labs(x = lab, y = "Tmax water (°C)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
})

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Water temperature vs predictors — Camp Polk (May–Sep)")
```

# 5. Lag Effect — Does Yesterday's Temperature Matter?

```{r lag-effect}
p_lag <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(twater_lag1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = twater_lag1, y = twater_max)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, color = "#185FA5", size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#E24B4A", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title    = "Lag effect — yesterday vs today water temperature (Camp Polk)",
    subtitle = "Dashed = 1:1 line",
    x = "Yesterday Tmax (°C)", y = "Today Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_lag)
```

# 6. Correlation Table — Quick Numeric Summary

```{r correlation-table}
cor_vars <- df |>
  select(twater_max, twater_mean, air_max_c, air_min_c,
         cloud_pct, Q, julian, twater_lag1, air_max_lag1) |>
  drop_na()

cor_matrix <- cor(cor_vars, use = "complete.obs") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("variable") |>
  select(variable, twater_max, twater_mean) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(twater_max)))

cat("\n--- Correlations with water temperature (Camp Polk) ---\n")
print(cor_matrix)
```

# 7. Exceedance — How Often Does Tmax Exceed Key Thresholds?

```{r exceedance}
thresholds <- c(18, 20, 24)

exceedance <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(thresh) {
  df |>
    group_by(month_lab) |>
    summarise(
      pct_exceed = mean(twater_max >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(threshold = paste0(thresh, "°C"))
})

p_exceed <- ggplot(exceedance,
                   aes(x = month_lab, y = pct_exceed,
                       color = threshold, group = threshold)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("18°C" = "#EF9F27", "20°C" = "#E24B4A", "24°C" = "#791F1F"),
    name = "Threshold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Frequency of temperature exceedance by month — Camp Polk",
    x = NULL, y = "% of days exceeding threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_exceed)
```

# 8. RM 8.5 Overview

```{r rm85-prep}
# Prepare RM 8.5 — May–September, max statistic
rm85 <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  mutate(
    date      = as.Date(date),
    year      = year(date),
    month     = month(date),
    julian    = yday(date),
    month_lab = month(date, label = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(month >= 5, month <= 9)

rm85_max <- rm85 |> filter(statistic == "max")
```

## 8a. Annual Trends at RM 8.5

```{r rm85-annual}
rm85 |>
  filter(statistic %in% c("max", "mean")) |>
  group_by(year, statistic) |>
  summarise(avg_temp = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(statistic = recode(statistic, max = "Max", mean = "Mean")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = avg_temp, color = statistic)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Max = "#9A8822", Mean = "#F5CDB4")) +
  labs(title = "Annual mean water temperature at RM 8.5 (May–Sep)",
       x = NULL, y = "°C", color = "Statistic") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 8b. Seasonal Pattern at RM 8.5

```{r rm85-seasonal}
rm85_max |>
  group_by(julian) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tmax   = sd(temperature,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"

                  ymax = mean_tmax + sd_tmax),

```

```{r rm85-exceedance}
map_dfr(c(18, 20, 24), function(thresh) {

}) |>
```

# 9. RM 8.5 vs RM 6 Temperature Relationship

```{r rm6-prep}
# Prepare RM 6 — May–September, max statistic
rm6_max <- rm_6_historical |>
  mutate(
    date      = as.Date(date),
    year      = year(date),
    month     = month(date),
    month_lab = month(date, label = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(month >= 5, month <= 9, statistic == "max")
```

```{r rm85-vs-rm6}
# Join RM 8.5 and RM 6 on date
rm_joint <- rm85_max |>
  select(date, month_lab, temp_rm85 = temperature) |>
  inner_join(
    rm6_max |> select(date, temp_rm6 = temperature),
    by = "date"
  ) |>
  drop_na()

cat("Paired days (RM 8.5 & RM 6):", nrow(rm_joint), "\n")

# Correlation
r_val <- cor(rm_joint$temp_rm85, rm_joint$temp_rm6, use = "complete.obs")
cat(sprintf("Pearson r (RM 8.5 vs RM 6 Tmax): %.3f\n", r_val))
```

## 9a. Scatter: RM 8.5 vs RM 6 Daily Max Temperature

```{r rm85-rm6-scatter}
lm_fit <- lm(temp_rm85 ~ temp_rm6, data = rm_joint)

ggplot(rm_joint, aes(x = temp_rm6, y = temp_rm85, color = month_lab)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black",
              linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey60",
              linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", name = "Month") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
           label = sprintf("r = %.3f  |  slope = %.2f  |  intercept = %.2f",
                           r_val, coef(lm_fit)[2], coef(lm_fit)[1]),
           size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title    = "RM 8.5 vs RM 6 — daily max water temperature (May–Sep)",
    subtitle = "Dotted = 1:1 line; dashed = OLS fit",
    x = "RM 6 Tmax (°C)", y = "RM 8.5 Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 9b. Difference (RM 8.5 − RM 6) Through the Season

```{r rm85-rm6-diff}
rm_joint |>
  mutate(
    diff      = temp_rm85 - temp_rm6,
    julian    = yday(date)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = julian, y = diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = month_lab), alpha = 0.3, size = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = TRUE,
              color = "#D2848A", fill = "#D2848A", alpha = 0.15,
              linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", name = "Month") +
  labs(
    title    = "Temperature difference (RM 8.5 − RM 6) across the season",
    subtitle = "Positive = RM 8.5 warmer than RM 6",
    x = "Julian day", y = "Tmax difference (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 9c. Difference by Month

```{r rm85-rm6-boxplot}
rm_joint |>
  mutate(diff = temp_rm85 - temp_rm6) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_lab, y = diff, fill = month_lab)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = "RM 8.5 − RM 6 temperature difference by month",
    x = NULL, y = "Tmax difference (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# 10. RM 6 Temperature vs Camp Polk Flow

```{r rm6-flow-prep}
# Join RM 6 max temp with Camp Polk discharge
rm6_flow <- rm6_max |>
  select(date, month_lab, temp_rm6 = temperature) |>
  inner_join(
    obs_flow |> mutate(date = as.Date(date)),
    by = "date"
  ) |>
  drop_na()

cat("Paired days (RM 6 temp & Camp Polk flow):", nrow(rm6_flow), "\n")

r_flow <- cor(rm6_flow$temp_rm6, rm6_flow$Q, use = "complete.obs")
cat(sprintf("Pearson r (RM 6 Tmax vs Camp Polk Q): %.3f\n", r_flow))
```

## 10a. Scatter: RM 6 Temperature vs Camp Polk Flow

```{r rm6-flow-scatter}
ggplot(rm6_flow, aes(x = Q, y = temp_rm6, color = month_lab)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black",
              linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Month") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
           label = sprintf("r = %.3f", r_flow),
           size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title    = "RM 6 Tmax vs Camp Polk flow (May–Sep)",
    subtitle = "x-axis on log scale",
    x = "Camp Polk discharge (cfs, log scale)", y = "RM 6 Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 10b. RM 6 Temperature vs Flow — by Month

```{r rm6-flow-facet, fig.height=7}
ggplot(rm6_flow, aes(x = Q, y = temp_rm6)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.9, color = "#74A089") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#185FA5",
              linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  facet_wrap(~month_lab, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "RM 6 Tmax vs Camp Polk flow — faceted by month",
    x = "Camp Polk discharge (cfs, log scale)", y = "RM 6 Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 10c. Flow Quantile Bins vs RM 6 Temperature

```{r rm6-flow-quantile}
rm6_flow |>
  mutate(
    Q_bin = cut(Q,
                breaks = quantile(Q, probs = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
                                  na.rm = TRUE),
                labels = c("Q1\n(lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5\n(highest)"),
                include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Q_bin, y = temp_rm6, fill = Q_bin)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(
    title    = "RM 6 Tmax by Camp Polk flow quintile (May–Sep)",
    subtitle = "Higher flow generally associated with cooler temperatures",
    x = "Flow quintile (Camp Polk)", y = "RM 6 Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
